newsitem.title: POLAND: DHL opens second Polish operations base.
newsitem.headline: DHL opens second Polish operations base.

text.p: The courier service firm DHL opened on Thursday its second Polish international operations base at the Pyrzowice airport in the southern city of Katowice to improve southern Poland's coverage, a DHL official said.

Pawel Rojan from the company's marketing department told Reuters the Pyrzowice base would be serviced directly by a DHL airplane from Brussels. The first base is at Warsaw's Okecie airport, also serviced by a separate DHL plane.
"The Pyrzowice base will help improve the coverage of southern Poland and boost our business there," Rojan said. He said DHL had 60-70 percent of courier services in Poland.
Since 1990, DHL has opened 18 offices country-wide, investing $22 million.
